chapterTitle: Chapter 1: The Winged Whales resting ground (Ceres)
editorText:
John made his way over to the bridge blast doors, paused then bowed his head. “Commander” in a drawn out dismissal tainted uncertainty but with hope, in that hope; respect. Then he left down the Balaenopteras long halls directed straight to the transport pods presenting his wrist terminal with a notification. Kitten chirped with sweetness as John tapped the notification. “Deep space Training to commence in 15 minutes”. John sped up his pace, “Thanks Kitten”, “Fuck” he though to himself. he was going to possibly miss Mess, and have to teach running on fumes.

He thought of the intricacies of the suit and it’s integration to the Iris, the web of information he would have to so elegantly engage the team into. He knew he had to be quick.

His team had already begun eating without him as he glanced over at them, stuffing their faces, formidable colleagues reduced to primitive apes in the little down time they had to enjoy themselves. He liked them this way. Tex looked John dead in the eyes. Then let out an abrupt burp followed up by a deep croaky groan chasing after as he leaned over holding his stomach. His face turned red like a beetroot ridden with pain about to burst. like a wounded gorilla he amusingly waddled off to the toilet bays in a somehow collected panic.

“I don’t think the new Salmon”, said Shai softly with a sweet innocence, seeming unamused by the food on her plate in a flat tone. “The salmon be slammin I see, chuckled Tau”. “Slammin on the wrong door in a minute” laughed Shai.

 The others will still be waking up. John raised his eyebrows, they rolled briefly then went back to normal. the speed of the drop spoke fast as he thought “Why, am I not surprised”. The flatness after raising his eyebrows said everything.  “Don’t wait up, you’ll need your energy” Said John. The team looked up at John unphased really, with unspoken trust, yet confusion. “Wait, why are you late?” Said Tao, “And what’s up with you” Tao continued forking her freshly cooked Puk Choy around, she was known for a strong staples in her vegetable intake. “You seem a little sketchy” she remarked, looking up at John with a smirk, as she slurped up a thick leaf of Bok Choy. While ungraceful she had beautiful confidence.  She armoured any self-doubtful thoughts with trust in her engineering prowess yet empathetic concern for the gravity that was often laid on John’s shoulder. John looked up at Tao, and chuckled. “Just as soon as you think we are going to get a break, right before the deepspace escort. then we have this” John pressed a button in the middle of the table ejecting a small holographic map. The North of Nepal could be seen, and deep within the belly of the winding mountains, like dragon backs , Tectonic plates scattered and lying to wake. “The Himalayas, 90 % more prone to tectonic movement, than anywhere else in the world.” John began, then paused for a moment allowing the others to observe the winding mountain valley’s. The map imbued a sense of mystery to the viewer. “And we have been selected to go into this” John sighed then continued. “The Long Range listeners have picked up a distress beacon, from deep within this valley. The commander's orders are to investigate, this will be a short in and out, then we are off to Europa” John’s team all stopped chewing for a moment.  I’ll fill you in more after the deep space training, we will be covering some elements of the new field suit as we go”. At this John selected the salmon to confirm what in fact was wrong with Tex, he knew it wasn’t the Salmon, he’d been off since his bender on the weekend. “I don’t think it’s the salmon, probably just the aroma of it all, bringing back memories from the weekend there pal “John shot a cheeky smirk Tex’s way and bobbed his head in his general direction. I heard he got lucky”, Momentarily after John had selected his meal, A distant humming could be felt across the room. A transparent cylindrical pod with a sphere on the top emanated from the center of the mess hall. Within its isolated environment an articulated robotic arm hummed. Zipping back and forth in repetitive stream-like motion, slowly but consistently strafing in one direction, leaving behind a fresh slab of Europa Salmon. Momentarily, the table John and his team sat at shot up a plate from within its stemming support base on a table akin to a large Lazy susan. Yet the base of it is about 9 inches thick, just enough to support a rolling transport index system which transported the food right to the diner, interwoven all the way through a small network of about 300 seats, underneath the flooring to a self contained printing module. “One more thing” John let out just after unwrapping his utensils from their packaging. “Athos wanted this under wraps. The facility is an Unknown facility, we have 0 information on the ground, all we know is that there has been a distress beacon activated and we are to investigate, so stay away from the bars, and the exotics, keep sharp” John looked over at Tex “You will need your wits about you. And I would probably suggest doing some puzzles, to prompt a creative approach, of all the training and simulated entries, this terrain is difficult, and hard to anticipate, take this as your unofficial brief”.Tao murmured as she broke apart the synthetic layers of machine printed salmon flesh. “I thought there was a kicker”, She bowed her head and continued eating. Shai was still engaged, “Ah John, what about those inertia sensors in the thrust correctional system, have they been patched?” Said Shai softly, “Now Shai, don’t blame the gear” chuckled John Jokingly, then continued more faint heartedly “But yes Shai, I have replaced the inertial sensors. the firmware of the sensors has been aligned with the new sensor calibrations, I did it in the suit’s inbuilt HMI” Shai looked slightly puzzled momentarily, then John explained. “Human Machine Interface, I’ll explain more in the training tomorrow. There’s been a few updates with the suit”.
